text:
The pilot gives you a few things to work with. You tested the new help page with 12 customers. Nine of them found the refund policy on their own, three needed a link from a staff member. You didn't measure how long any of it took. The next test runs on November 4. It keeps the same wording but puts in a larger Refunds button.

You can't say much about the whole support landscape from that small a group. That said the fact that three out of twelve still got stuck is worth looking at. If the bigger button fixes it you'll know by the time that second round is done. If it doesn't you'll have to try something else.
